name: @speedora/candidate-shortlist
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): AI Intelligence v4 Phase 13.2 (Clip Ranking Engine, Stage B) - a cheap, transcript-only pre-rank shortlisting an expanded candidate pool (Phase 13.1) down to a size the render-graph can affordably run on, combining already-computed ClipScores/viralityScore with two new transcript-only LLM calls (Semantic Event Detection, Narrative Graph). No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/ai/clip-ranking-engine.md. Consumed by apps/worker's detect-clips adapter.
